agent.problem: The setup says only that Christ Jesus died, was raised to life, and is at God's right hand. It gives the baker no basis for choosing "interceding" over "waiting" or "watching," so the blank asks them to guess wording they have not seen rather than reason out the meaning.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
